_comment: Qwen3.5-9B geometry on a 7 nm-class die with one HBM3E stack per layer ASIC. Fabric at 1.43 GHz (ASAP7 signoff): 4 passes x 2048 cycles = 5.7 us per layer, 1.5 us per head die; global compute phases scaled by the same clock ratio, and the index-scan compute by the 4x fewer compressed positions as well. int4 KV at 16:1 compression, 1 TB/s per die, 128 resident contexts (HBM capacity allows thousands), an 8 GB/s ring link, 1 pJ per MAC, and 30 pJ per byte for HBM. Pass-level pipelining is not modeled, so a layer stage still admits one token per layer latency.
